searchText: Guys, naive question Is there an upper cap on the number of ETH that can be burnt via EIP-1599? No hard cap, no. Also, <#692078615269212180> Like where does the burning stop? Won't all the ETH get burnt then? Or is the time taken for the same going to be close to infinite and hence it's okay? Basically, yes.
